card.name: Digits and names inside dates, URLs, phones
card.fires_on: Pieces inside web-page clutter: a digit within a date, URL or phone number, or a name or French date word in a byline. It also fires on 'said' after a quoted source in news text.

modes.label: Digits in dates and numbers
modes.description: A single digit or word piece inside a URL date, phone number or French date stamp.

modes.label: Names and URL pieces
modes.description: Part of a byline name or a URL path segment.
modes.example: By Show and Tell By Byron Graham By Jamie Siebrase By B<<ree>> Davies By Zoe Yabrove

modes.label: Said after a named source
modes.description: The verb 'said' following a named person in a news quote.
modes.example: Tomoko Murakami, a nuclear analyst at the Institute of Energy Economics Japan,<< said>> by phone today.

card.writes: It slightly favors formal linking words and discourages slangy words like 'shit' and 'kinda'.
card.plain: It fires on digits and name pieces in dates, web addresses and bylines, and on 'said' in news quotes.
